The '''''Fowler''''' was a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, the ''Lancer'' was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], and it was subsequently refitted by the Alliance for use as an anti-[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] attack platform. The ''Fowler'' performed an anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] role on a number of strike missions, in support of Alliance [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], and it achieved a large number of combat kills. The ''Fowler'' later saw service with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Alliance's successor government, and it was eventually decommissioned.
